Research Supplies

This list shows research whose University level, parent research, and other building or colony requirements are fulfilled, but whose complete item cost is not yet in the University inventory.

Deliver requests the outstanding items from all colony warehouses. Deliver & Start also starts the research automatically after every item arrives and a research slot becomes available, even while players are offline.

Item colors show whether the colony warehouses contain all, some, or none of each outstanding cost.
